name: tasks
description: Keeps the task list honest: one task in progress at a time, finished work marked done, a list that survives compaction and completion, and reminders that name the stale task.

nudgeAfterTools.title: Ask for a task list after (tool calls)
nudgeAfterTools.description: When a turn has run this many tool calls with no task list open, the model is asked to create one. 0 turns the nudge off.

keepGoing.title: Keep going when work is left
keepGoing.description: When a turn ends with a task that is not on hold and nothing pending to wake the session (a CI watch, a plan-limit pause, or a pause whose automatic resume was cancelled, until its reset), the model is prompted to carry on. Stops after two prompts in a row that change nothing on the list, and never after an interrupted turn.
